summary: Claude ran plan.md with subagent-driven development and finished all four tasks. Each task got its own implementer and then a reviewer, in strict order, and a final whole-branch review came after task 4. The session ended in the finishing-a-development-branch step, where I answered "Keep the branch as-is". The session log shows 18 compaction boundaries, and the controller still kept its task loop: after a compaction it said it was re-reading the skill and the ledger.
reasoning: I checked every criterion against the files on disk, git history, npm test output and the session log timestamps, and all four pass. Even with heavy, repeated compaction, the controller kept the order implement, review, next task, then ran a final review and the finishing step. The one odd behaviour is that HEAD was detached after 'Keep the branch as-is'. I've reported it, but it doesn't break any criterion.

observations.description: Startup showed several dialogs before the prompt: theme picker, security notes, trust-folder prompt, a 'Newer Opus model available' prompt, and the bypass-permissions warning. On the trust-folder and bypass prompts the cursor starts on 'No, exit'. The model prompt said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5' even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I answered No, and the header still showed Opus 5.5.

I chose 'Keep the branch as-is', but the agent also detached HEAD at 0ffcef2 and 'released this session's lease on the branch'. Afterwards git branch shows '(HEAD detached at 0ffcef2)' plus a new 'hyperpowers/state' branch. A user asking to keep the branch probably expects to stay checked out on feature/textstats.
The finishing message asked 'This branch split from main - is that correct?' and the merge/PR/keep question in the same turn. One reply has to cover both.

Before starting, the agent asked how to handle test gaps in the plan: PASSAGE constants that are never used, and edge cases the plan describes but doesn't test. I answered 'Proceed as you recommend.' and it added the missing tests, so the plan's 32 tests became 75. The question was reasonable, but the plan fixture itself seems to have these inconsistencies.

Compaction happened very often: 18 compact_boundary entries in roughly 22 minutes, and the screen showed '0% until auto-compact'. That matches the small compaction window the scenario sets up. The controller re-read its skill and ledger files after compacting ('re-reading the skill and the ledger as the compaction notice requires'). The whole run took about 26 minutes.
After a compaction the screen fills with long 'Referenced file ../../../../../../../../.cache/...' lines, which make the transcript hard to follow.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has its own test file, they are committed, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js line 141: `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. test/ contains wordCount.test.js, sentenceCount.test.js, topWords.test.js and readingTimeMinutes.test.js. git log shows bf42b20 feat: add wordCount, 2d443bb sentenceCount, 8976ddc topWords, 0ffcef2 readingTimeMinutes. npm test: `tests 75 … pass 75 fail 0`

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Times from the Agent tool calls in the session log and the subagent logs: Implement T1 18:24:06 → Review T1 18:26:31 (ended 18:26:42) → Implement T2 18:29:19 → Review T2 18:30:53 (ended 18:31:10) → Implement T3 18:34:16 → Review T3 18:36:00 (ended 18:36:16) → Implement T4 18:38:36 → Review T4 18:40:50 (ended 18:41:02). The tasks never overlapped.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Session log has the Agent call 'Final whole-branch review' at 18:43:09, after Review Task 4. Its subagent log starts 'You are a Senior Code Reviewer…' and ends at 18:44:08.

criteria.criterion: The session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Skill call hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch appears in the log. The screen showed 'Implementation complete. What would you like to do? 1. Merge … 2. Push … 3. Keep the branch as-is'. After I replied 'Keep the branch as-is', it answered 'I've kept feature/textstats as it is at 0ffcef2… Nothing was merged or pushed.'
